'''Hashar''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] living during the [[Galactic War]]. In [[3630 BBY]] he answered the call by [[Mandalore the Avenger]] to join the clans in a [[Raid on Darvannis|raid]] on [[Darvannis factory|droid factory]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Darvannis]]. He was in the team led by [[Breyer Chorn]] with the goal to disable the shield generators and was one of the dozen warriors who fell to [[Eternal Empire]] [[Skytrooper]]s along the way.<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Hashar is mentioned in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Fallen Empire]]'' '''Chapter 14: Mandalore the Avenger'''.
